newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent up and supported by API data.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent up and supported by API data.

text.p: May Brent crude futures were higher in late trading on Wednesday, supported by a firm NYMEX market in the wake of API data.
May Brent was last traded at $19.61 per barrel, up seven cents from London's overnight settlement at $19.54.
Brokers said they expected prices to hold above $19.50 on Tuesday. May fell to $19.46 in London on Tuesday but found good support.
In addition, the API statistics have buoyed NYMEX crude after they showed a jump in refinery use in the United States and a surprise draw in crude stocks.
The API said refinery use rose to 92.7 percent from 90.4 percent. Crude stocks fell 2.2 million barrels when a build had been expected.
The data pushed NYMEX May crude to last trade on ACCESS at $21.09, up 10 cents.
